reasoning: The only complete review (deepseek-v4-flash) found all files safe. The PKGBUILD downloads prebuilt binaries from the project's official domain (static.ampcode.com) with pinned SHA-256 checksums, preventing substitution attacks. The latestver() function uses curl but is only invoked during pkgver(), not during sourcing or build phases. No malicious code execution, no unexpected network requests during build, and no execution of fetched content. This follows standard AUR practices for binary packages.
